planets.name: TOI-5728 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5728 with a 11.5-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-5728 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5728. Its orbit and size follow Gomez Barrientos et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
